basic_info.description: Three flats for the price of one! Offered for sale are three spacious flats at 1558, 1564 and 1568 Jones Street, a 15 unit TIC building located in a great north side location where Nob Hill and Russian Hill meet. 1564 is a vacant top floor 1436 square foot 3BD/1BA flat awaiting a new owners touch and perfect for an owner occupier. 1558 and 1568 Jones are a pair of 3 bedroom flats that are tenant occupied by long term tenants that pay $836.62 and 681.66 respectively. All three units are to be sold together in a package deal that includes three car parking. Building has a shared roof deck with panoramic bridge to bridge views. This is a unique opportunity for either an owner user or investor. Don't miss! Offering is three TIC interests that must sell together.
